stem: Based on the excerpt and your knowledge of U.S. history, which statement describes an effect of this document?

options.label: A
options.text: It outlined the process for creating new states.

options.label: B
options.text: It authorized the expansion of slavery to new states.

options.label: C
options.text: It limited the individual rights of citizens in new states.

options.label: D
options.text: It discouraged the creation of schools in new states.

visual_elements:
And, whenever any of the said States shall have sixty thousand free inhabitants therein, such State shall be admitted, by its delegates, into the Congress of the United States, on [equal terms] with the original States in all respects whatever, and shall be at liberty to form a permanent constitution and State government.
—An Ordinance for the Government of the Territory of the United States North-West of the River Ohio
